福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・中西區

祀典武廟The Official God of War Temple

認識三國名將關羽、清代的官方祀典、永福路上的長紅牆與大丈夫匾，還有府城有名的拐杖月老。

Meet Guan Yu, the loyal general, and learn about state rites, the long red wall, the famous plaque and Yue Lao.

赤崁樓對面，一道長長紅牆後面，是府城最氣派的廟宇之一，供奉關公。關羽是三國名將，紅臉長鬍，後來成為忠義之神。在小說裡，他手持青龍偃月刀，騎著原屬呂布的赤兔馬。武廟始於明鄭時期；1727 年清廷把它列入祀典，春秋官祭。沿永福路欣賞紅色馬背山牆；廟裡的「大丈夫」匾讚頌頂天立地的男子漢。單身的人向拐杖月老求紅線，商人則向關公祈求生意誠信興隆。

Across from Chihkan Tower, a long red wall hides one of Tainan's grandest temples, home of Guan Gong. Guan Yu was a general of the Three Kingdoms era. With his red face and long beard, he became the god of loyalty. In the famous novel, he carries the Green Dragon Crescent Blade and rides Red Hare, a horse once owned by Lu Bu. The temple goes back to the Ming Zheng era. In 1727 the Qing government made it a temple of official spring and autumn rites. Walk along Yongfu Road to see the red horseback gables. Inside, the Da Zhang Fu plaque praises a true man of honor. Singles ask the Cane Yue Lao for a red thread, and merchants pray to Guan Gong for honest business and good fortune.

一分鐘看懂

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history
  1. 忠義關公關羽是三國時代的名將，死後成為人人敬拜的關聖帝君。Guan Yu was a great general of the Three Kingdoms era. After his death, people began to worship him as a god.
  2. 什麼是祀典「祀典」代表官府把這座廟列入官方祭祀，地方官每年都要來致祭。Sidian means the government put the temple on its list of official rites.
  3. 紅牆與名匾從永福路看過去，一道朱紅長牆，上面高低起伏的屋頂，是府城最美的廟景之一。From Yongfu Road you see a long red wall with roofs rising and falling above it.
  4. 月老與守護武廟裡不只有關公，拐杖月老更是府城有名的姻緣神。Guan Gong is not alone here. The Cane Yue Lao is one of Tainan's best-known matchmakers.

認識景點

About the place

忠義關公Guan Gong, the loyal hero

桃園三結義：《三國演義》說關羽、劉備、張飛在桃園結拜；這是小說情節，不是正史。 忠義：史書記載他曾暫留曹營，報恩後仍回到劉備身邊。 紅臉長鬍：小說寫他面如重棗、留長鬍子，神像就照這個樣子塑。 青龍偃月刀：長柄大刀，名字出自小說；史書沒有記載他用什麼兵器。

The peach garden oath: In the novel, Guan Yu, Liu Bei and Zhang Fei swear to be brothers in a peach garden. It is a story, not history. loyalty: He once stayed with Cao Cao, but after repaying him, he went back to Liu Bei. Red face, long beard: The novel gives him a dark red face and a long beard, and statues follow it. Green Dragon Crescent Blade: A big blade on a long pole. The name comes from the novel, not from history books.

赤兔馬：原是呂布的坐騎；小說裡曹操把牠送給關羽。 武聖：孔子被尊為文聖，關公則被尊為武聖，地位相當。

Red Hare: was Lu Bu's horse. In the novel, Cao Cao gives it to Guan Yu. Saint of War: Confucius is the Saint of Culture, and Guan Gong is the Saint of War.

什麼是祀典A temple of state rites

明鄭時期的關帝廟：一般說建於明鄭時期約 1665 年，確切年份史料說法不一。 1690 年重修：清朝官員王效宗擴建，大門改為朝南。 1727 年列入祀典：雍正五年起，官府每年春、秋兩季來祭拜關公。 春秋祭典：今天仍有市長主祭的春祭與秋祭，有古樂與佾舞。

A Ming Zheng temple: It goes back to the Ming Zheng era, around 1665, though records disagree on the year. Rebuilt in 1690: A Qing official enlarged the temple and turned its main gate to face south. State rites from 1727: From 1727, officials came to honor Guan Gong every spring and autumn. Spring and autumn rites: Today the mayor still leads spring and autumn rites, with old music and dance.

國定古蹟：1983 年列為第一批一級古蹟，現為國定古蹟。

A national monument: In 1983 it became a grade one historic site. Today it is a national monument.

紅牆與名匾The red wall and plaques

朱紅長山牆：整座廟前後約 66 公尺，紅色山牆沿著永福路一路延伸。 馬背山牆：牆頂圓弧起伏，像馬背一樣，所以叫「馬背」。 高低起伏的屋頂：三川門、拜殿、正殿、後殿屋頂一進比一進高，形成起伏的天際線。 古今一人匾：落款「術桂書」，是明朝寧靖王朱術桂；意思是從古到今只有關公一人。據說原匾已遺失，現在的是仿製品。

The long red gable wall: The temple is about 66 meters long, and its red gable wall runs along Yongfu Road. Horseback gables: The rounded tops of the wall look like a horse's back. Roofs rising and falling: The halls have different roofs, so the skyline rises and falls like waves. One of a kind: It is signed by Prince Ningjing of the Ming. It means Guan Gong is one of a kind. It is said this is a copy of the lost old plaque.

文武聖人匾：1696 年（康熙丙子）的匾，據記載由清代官員高拱乾所立，稱讚關公文武雙全。 大丈夫匾：據市府資料，由臺灣道楊廷理於乾隆五十九年（1794）敬獻；有些資料記為 1791 年。字句出自《孟子》。 何謂大丈夫：孟子說：富貴不能淫，貧賤不能移，威武不能屈。 人倫之至匾：字句出自《孟子》，稱讚關公是做人的最好榜樣。據記載是清代武官徐慶超在 1814 年獻的。

Saint of culture and war: A plaque from 1696. It praises Guan Gong as a saint of both culture and war. The Da Zhang Fu plaque: City records say Qing official Yang Tingli presented it in 1794. The words come from Mencius. What is a true man?: Mencius said a true man cannot be bought by riches, moved by poverty, or bent by force. The best example: The words come from Mencius. They praise Guan Gong as the best example of how to live. Records say a Qing army officer gave it in 1814.

萬世人極匾：咸豐皇帝御筆「萬世人極」，意思是萬世做人的最高典範。 文經武緯匾：稱讚一個人文武雙全、能治理國家。據記載是清代光緒年間的匾，匾下掛著一面大鼓。 三代廳：正殿後面的後殿，供奉關公的三代祖先。

The Emperor's plaque: Emperor Xianfeng wrote it. It calls Guan Gong the highest model for all ages. Learning and fighting: It praises someone good at both learning and fighting. Records say it is from the late Qing. A big drum hangs below it. Hall of three generations: The rear hall honors three generations of Guan Gong's ancestors.

月老與守護Yue Lao and other blessings

月下老人：月老用紅線把有緣人綁在一起。 拐杖月老：這尊月老手握拐杖，民間說他擅長斬斷爛桃花。 府城四大月老：民間流傳的說法：武廟、大天后宮、大觀音亭、重慶寺的月老合稱府城四大月老。 送喜餅還願：求到好姻緣的人，常帶喜餅、水果回來答謝。

The Old Man under the Moon: Yue Lao ties a red thread between two people who are meant to be together. The Cane Yue Lao: This Yue Lao holds a cane. People say he is good at cutting off bad romances. Tainan's four Yue Lao: People often name four famous Yue Lao in Tainan, and this temple is one of them. Wedding cake to say thanks: When a wish comes true, couples often bring wedding cake and fruit to say thanks.

商人的守護神：做生意講誠信，許多商人把象徵忠義的關公當財神敬拜。 求籤：從籤筒抽一支有號碼的籤，再到籤詩櫃打開同號碼的抽屜，拿出籤詩。 五文昌帝君：保佑讀書、考試，關公也是其中一位。相傳關公生前喜歡讀《左氏春秋》，也懂得書中的大道理，所以被尊為「文衡聖帝」，不只是一位武將。 馬使爺廳：武廟對面的附屬小廟，供奉赤兔馬和照顧牠的馬使爺；門口放著青草和水。

Patron of merchants: Business needs trust, so many merchants honor Guan Gong as a god of wealth. Fortune poems: Pick a numbered stick, then open the drawer with the same number to find your fortune poem. Five gods of learning: are honored here, and Guan Gong is one of them. It is said Guan Gong loved reading the Spring and Autumn Annals and understood its deep lessons. So he is also honored as a god of learning, not only as a warrior. The Horse Master Hall: Across the road, a small hall honors Red Hare, Guan Gong's horse, and the Horse Master who cared for it.

實景照片

Photos on site

永福路上的紅牆 The long red wall

沿著永福路走，就會看到祀典武廟長長的朱紅色山牆，牆頂像波浪一樣起伏，整面牆只開了一扇小拱門。很多人說這是全臺最美的廟宇山牆。

Walk along Yongfu Road and you will see the temple's long red wall. Its top rises and falls like waves. Many people call it the most beautiful temple wall in Taiwan.

三川門 The front gate

這是祀典武廟的大門「三川門」。中間掛著綠底金字的「武廟」直匾，兩邊掛著大燈籠，紅色對聯寫著「聖君德澤護臺疆」「關帝威儀維漢鼎」。

This is the front gate. The green board in the middle says Martial Temple. The red couplets on both sides praise Guan Gong.

大丈夫匾 The Da Zhang Fu plaque

大門上方掛著有名的「大丈夫」匾。右邊小字寫著「乾隆甲寅中秋」，也就是 1794 年；左邊落款是清代官員楊廷理。字句出自《孟子》。

Above the front door hangs the famous Da Zhang Fu plaque. It means a true man of honor. The small words say Qing official Yang Tingli gave it in 1794.

人倫之至匾 The best example plaque

走進三川殿抬頭看，黑底金字的「人倫之至」匾，意思是做人、待人最好的榜樣，用來稱讚關公；字句出自《孟子》。據資料記載，這是清代武官徐慶超在 1814 年（嘉慶十九年）獻的。

Look up inside the front hall. This black plaque calls Guan Gong the best example of how people should live and treat each other. Records say a Qing army officer gave it in 1814.

古今一人匾與銅鐘 One of a kind

「古今一人」的意思是從古到今只有這一位，稱讚關公獨一無二。落款「術桂書」，是明朝寧靖王朱術桂。據說原匾已經遺失，現在掛的是後來仿製的。匾下有一口銅鐘，鐘上鑄著「關帝殿」三個字。

This plaque means one of a kind, from ancient times to today. It is signed by Prince Ningjing of the Ming. It is said the old plaque was lost, and this one is a copy. The bronze bell below says Guandi Hall.

文經武緯匾與大鼓 Plaque and drum

「文經武緯」稱讚一個人文才、武藝都很好，能把國家治理好。據資料記載，這是清代光緒年間的匾。匾下掛著一面大鼓。

This plaque praises someone who is good at both learning and fighting. Records say it is from the late Qing dynasty. A big drum hangs below it.

文武聖人匾 Saint of culture and war

「文武聖人」稱讚關公是文武雙全的聖人。右邊小字寫著「康熙丙子」，也就是 1696 年；據資料記載，是清代官員高拱乾所立。

This plaque calls Guan Gong a saint of both culture and war. The small words date it to 1696. Records say a Qing official gave it.

寫著武廟的瓦 Tiles that say Martial Temple

抬頭看屋簷：一片片綠色的滴水瓦上，都印著「武廟」兩個字！後面那個紅色的大方塊，是古代錢幣「布幣」的形狀；據說慶典時可以在上面架橫樑、搭棚子。

Look up at the roof edge. Each green tile says Martial Temple! Behind it, the red block is shaped like old spade money. It is said that people rest beams on it to put up a canopy for festivals.

天井與大殿 The courtyard

走過天井，就來到拜關公的大殿前。屋脊上有兩條綠色的龍，中間是一座小寶塔；燈籠寫著「關帝聖君」，匾上寫著「文武聖衡」。天井裡有大香爐和一把大刀。

Cross the courtyard to the main hall. Two green dragons sit on the roof ridge, and the lanterns say Guandi, the holy lord. A big censer and a big blade stand in the courtyard.

大刀 The big blade

天井裡立著一把長柄大刀，放在有兩條龍的刀架上，底座寫著「台灣祀典武廟」。它讓人想到小說裡關公的青龍偃月刀。

A big blade on a long pole stands on a stand with two dragons. It reminds people of Guan Gong's Green Dragon Crescent Blade from the novel.

籤筒 Fortune sticks

木頭籤筒裡插滿了籤。求籤的人先誠心向神明說出問題，再從籤筒抽出一支籤，籤上有號碼。

This wooden cup holds fortune sticks. People ask Guan Gong a question, then pick out one stick with a number on it.

籤詩櫃 The fortune poem drawers

籤詩櫃有一百個小抽屜，上面刻著「台灣祀典武廟 文衡聖帝聖籤」。抽到幾號籤，就打開同號碼的抽屜，拿出那首籤詩。

This cabinet has one hundred small drawers. Find the drawer with the same number as your stick, and take out your fortune poem.

三代廳 Hall of three generations

正殿後面的三代廳，供奉關公的三代祖先：曾祖父、祖父和父親。屋脊兩端像燕子尾巴一樣翹起。

Behind the main hall is a hall for Guan Gong's family. It honors his father, grandfather and great-grandfather.

五文昌帝君 Five gods of learning

這裡供奉「五文昌帝君」，是保佑讀書、考試的五位神明。據資料，五文昌包括文昌帝君、魁星、朱衣神君、呂洞賓和關公。兩邊一格格亮著的小燈是光明燈，信眾點燈祈求平安。相傳關公生前喜歡讀《左氏春秋》，也懂得書中的大道理，所以被尊為「文衡聖帝」，不只是一位武將。

This shrine honors five gods of learning, and Guan Gong is one of them. People pray to them for help with study and tests. The rows of little lights are blessing lamps. It is said Guan Gong loved reading the Spring and Autumn Annals and understood its deep lessons. So he is also honored as a god of learning, not only as a warrior.

馬使爺廳 The Horse Master Hall

祀典武廟對面馬路旁的馬使爺廳，是武廟的附屬小廟，供奉關公的坐騎赤兔馬，和照顧赤兔馬的「馬使爺」。門邊對聯寫著「馬昔從征稱赤兔」「使今配祭薦青芻」。

Across the road is the Horse Master Hall. It honors Guan Gong's horse, Red Hare, and the Horse Master, who took care of the horse.

給馬的青草和水 Grass and water

門邊放著一大盆青草，後面還有一盆水。對聯寫著「薦青芻」，意思是獻上新鮮的青草。據說是準備給赤兔馬吃喝的。

Beside the door are a pot of green grass and a basin of water. It is said they are for Guan Gong's horse, Red Hare.

馬使爺神龕 The Horse Master altar

廳裡的神龕，布簾上寫著「馬使爺」三個字。馬使爺是替關公照顧赤兔馬的馬夫，手裡拿著馬韁繩。他和拿大刀的周倉將軍是不同的神明。

The cloth over the altar says Horse Master. He was the groom who looked after Red Hare, and he holds the reins. He is not Zhou Cang, the general who carries Guan Gong's blade.
